items.title: Bosshogg Macaroni is live!

chunks.text: A professional is the person who gets up and does the work every day. There is no daily debate about whether today counts. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=41
Waiting for a perfect moment is a different life from planning to be at the work again tomorrow. One reacts. The other keeps a streak. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=73

If the work is yours, you try it on ordinary days, including the days you would rather stay in. The feeling of being meant for it shows up as repetition. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=88
Handle the business when you wake up. The standard is the morning itself, not a speech about the morning. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=192
Lasting at something means you outwork the field. You do not hand the pace to whoever else showed up. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=223
If you do not yet know what the work consists of, you are in the learning steps. That is the start, not a failure. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=292
Visible results often come from value you already stored. The next good day is usually work that was banked earlier. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=480
Focus has to match. If someone is aimed at a different job, standing next to them does not put you on the same work. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=1440
Two hard days do not change a life. If you want something serious to give, expect a longer road than a weekend or even a couple of years. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=2400
Set a standard and keep moving when someone will not meet it. Arguing all day is not the work. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=2880
Keep working the thing. Most of the result is staying on it after the exciting part fades. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPhsICK_QI&t=3120

items.attribution: Original Brimmesa lesson notes for Coach Amara from Bosshogg Macaroni, YouTube live VtPhsICK_QI, channel https://www.youtube.com/@bosshoggmacaroni6462, about 61 minutes. Not a transcript and not the speaker's words. Profanity and street-business anecdotes were left out.
